Interface ReturnStmt

All Superinterfaces:
Acceptor<StmtVisitor>, EquivTo, Stmt
All Known Implementing Classes:
JReturnStmt, JReturnVoidStmt
public interface ReturnStmt extends Stmt
An interface representing a return statement. Implementations of this interface represent statements that cause a method to return. This may be a void return or a return with a value depending on the implementation.
